The '''Conjo Y41-T fighter''', also known as the '''Conjo trainer''' was a type of [[Conjo fighter]] built by [[Aratech Repulsor Company/Legends|Aratech]] for planetary defense forces. It was armed similarly to the [[Conjo Y41-C2LC fighter]] but featured less armoring, maneuvering and speed, making it easier for new pilots to control.<ref name="TABSB" />
